description.value:
Frequency once per round

Trigger You critically hit with a two-handed melee weapon.

The wind-up was for the first one. The second one was standing too close to somebody about to be hit very hard.

The critical hit's damage is also dealt, without the critical doubling, to one other creature within your reach and within 10 feet of the target. That creature may attempt a basic Reflex save against your Class DC. This cannot chain further, however tightly packed the room is.
